summary: 11 Residential wants a standardized, role-based setup that supports centralized work, strong reporting, affordable housing, student housing, and Washington compliance. The calls do not identify the first migration property, so property-specific recommendations below apply only when the selected property has the cited affordable or student characteristics. Several exact workflow thresholds remain open.

settings.setting: Create standardized groups for property managers, leasing, maintenance, property accounting, regional leadership, marketing, and system administrators.
settings.path: Setup >> Users & Groups >> Groups >> Add Group
settings.proposed: Create role-based groups before loading users.
settings.meaning: Permissions and work assignments will follow standardized job roles instead of being configured independently for every employee.
settings.assumption: Final permission details will be documented during process mapping.
reasoning: The client wants standardized workflows and clear accountability across properties.
They currently use role templates and want user setup, training assignments, and workflows to follow those roles.
Later discussions confirmed that Entrata groups should align with their identity-management and learning-management structure.
